description: This file contains a class 'Printer' and related functions for handling output and logging during webkit layout tests, including timing, test results, and debug information.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: Handles all non-debug-logging output for run-webkit-tests, including test result summaries, timing, and debug info.

methods.name: print_options
methods.description: Returns a list of command-line options for the testing output.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Printer with port, options, output, and optional logger.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the printer.

methods.name: __del__
methods.description: Destructor that ensures cleanup.

methods.name: print_config
methods.description: Prints the current test configuration details.

methods.name: print_found
methods.description: Outputs information about the number of tests found and selected for running.

methods.name: print_expected
methods.description: Prints expected test results categories.

methods.name: print_workers_and_shards
methods.description: Outputs information about worker threads and test shards.

methods.name: _print_expected_results_of_type
methods.description: Helper to print counts of tests of a specific result type.

methods.name: _num_digits
methods.description: Calculates number of digits for formatting.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Outputs timing and summary of test run results.

methods.name: _print_timing_statistics
methods.description: Prints detailed timing statistics.

methods.name: _print_worker_statistics
methods.description: Prints per-worker timing info.

methods.name: _print_aggregate_test_statistics
methods.description: Prints aggregate test timing info.

methods.name: _print_individual_test_times
methods.description: Prints info on individual slowest tests.

methods.name: _print_test_list_timing
methods.description: Prints timing info for a list of tests.

methods.name: _print_directory_timings
methods.description: Prints timings for test directories.

methods.name: _print_statistics_for_test_timings
methods.description: Prints statistical analysis of test timings.

methods.name: _print_one_line_summary
methods.description: Prints a one-line summary of test results.

methods.name: _test_status_line
methods.description: Generates a status line for a test.

methods.name: print_started_test
methods.description: Marks a test as started.

methods.name: print_finished_test
methods.description: Marks a test as finished and outputs result.

methods.name: _result_message
methods.description: Generates a message string based on test result.

methods.name: _print_test_trace
methods.description: Prints detailed trace info for a test.

methods.name: _print_baseline
methods.description: Prints baseline file info for a test.

methods.name: _print_quiet
methods.description: Prints a message quietly.

methods.name: _print_default
methods.description: Prints a message unless in quiet mode.

methods.name: _print_debug
methods.description: Prints debug message if debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: write_throttled_update
methods.description: Writes a throttled update to the output.

methods.name: write_update
methods.description: Writes an update to the output.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Writes a line to the output.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffer.
